philosophy: Promotes the stocks_rsi2_pullback emitter signal. Larry-Connors 2-day RSI mean-reversion in established uptrends. Buys equities trading above their 200-day SMA when RSI(2) drops below 10, exits on RSI(2) > 70 or 5-day hold cap. Live-confirmed Tier-2-trajectory edge.
entry_criteria: Symbol in S&P 500 universe (covered by stocks_rsi2_pullback emitter)
exit_criteria: RSI(2) > 70 OR hard time-stop at 5 trading days
Hard stop: close below entry day low
Take profit: +3% or hit of 5-day high, whichever first
suggested_backtesting_protocol: Walk-forward S&P 500 daily, 12mo IS / 3mo OOS. n>=100 closed picks required before promotion to live. Track PF and MDD monthly.
confidence_calibration: HIGH when RSI(2) < 5 and SPY also above its own 200SMA. MEDIUM at RSI(2) 5-10. LOW when uptrend regime is questionable (SPY below 50SMA).
worst_market_conditions: Crisis tape with index-level breaks of 200SMA
